title: Whether AVS works with animal welfare groups on the Trap-Neuter-Rehome/Release-Manage programme
asked: Ms Lee Hui Ying asked whether the Ministry or the Animal and Veterinary Service works with Animal Welfare Groups on the Trap-Neuter-Rehome/Release-Manage programme, and whether the groups and AVS consult before every trapping operation.
response: Mr Alvin Tan said AVS has worked with TNRM partners since 2018 on managing the free-roaming dog population, with partners conducting trapping and sterilisation and AVS working with the partner for the designated area once an unsterilised dog is identified. He cited the 14 November 2025 Seletar West Farmway 8 operation, where AVS' contractor trapped and removed three dogs confirmed by victims to have been involved in chasing and biting incidents, carried out under AVS staff supervision and in line with WOAH stray dog population control standards. He said AVS intends to review joint protocols and improve communication and coordination, and gave figures of 4,470 dogs trapped, 2,048 rehomed and 80% of the free-roaming dog population sterilised, above the 70% target, with an 80% reduction in feedback cases.

key_points.point: AVS has worked with its partners on the TNRM programme since 2018 to manage Singapore's free-roaming dog population
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: since 2018, the Animal and Veterinary Service (AVS) has worked with its partners on the Trap-Neuter-Rehome/Release-Manage (TNRM) programme

key_points.point: When an unsterilised free-roaming dog is identified, AVS works with the TNRM partner for that designated area to start trapping
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: Upon identification of an unsterilised free-roaming dog, AVS will work with the TNRM partner responsible for the designated area to commence trapping operations.

key_points.point: At Seletar West Farmway 8 on 14 November 2025, AVS' contractor trapped and removed three free-roaming dogs confirmed by several victims to have been involved in multiple chasing and biting incidents
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: AVS' animal management contractor was activated to trap and remove three free-roaming dogs, which were confirmed by several victims to have been involved in multiple chasing and biting incidents

key_points.point: The operation followed WOAH stray dog population control standards, including not using uncovered wire loops or ropes
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: complying with the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) standards on Stray Dog Population Control to ensure that uncovered wire loops or ropes were not used during the trapping process

key_points.point: AVS intends to review joint protocols and improve communication and coordination with TNRM partners
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we intend to review joint protocols and further improve communication and coordination

key_points.point: The review covers management of free-roaming dogs, trapping measures, coordination between AVS and partners, streamlining feedback channels and regular stakeholder engagements and workshops
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: streamlining feedback channels and conducting regular stakeholder engagements and workshops

key_points.point: A TNRM workshop is scheduled for 15 January and many partners will attend
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: I encouraged them to join our TNRM workshop that is scheduled for 15 January

key_points.point: To date 4,470 dogs have been trapped, 2,048 rehomed and 80% of the free-roaming dog population sterilised
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: we have thus far trapped 4,470 dogs, rehomed 2,048 dogs and sterilised 80% of the free-roaming dog population

key_points.point: The sterilisation rate is above the 70% target and feedback cases have fallen by 80%
key_points.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
key_points.quote: That is above our target of 70% and that has resulted in a reduction of 80% of feedback cases.

How the review will be conducted and when it will conclude
